metadata.qualification: Prototype generic codec-backed register MMA projection on actual Q4_0 banks, with balanced, skewed and fully active routing. Independent sampled F64 reference, FP16 operand rounding, full-output tolerance against tensor-core baseline and inactive sentinel preservation. No model-specific constants or weight conversion. Accumulation order differs from the tensor-core reference. Kernel-only evidence, not throughput proof.
